selection_rule: Among rank-two cells with recurrence at least 0.80 and observational fidelity above random p95, greedily select the largest local-minus-global advantage using distinct layers and distinct stratum families.

hypotheses.F0_native_replay_is_exact: The intervention code reproduces native logits with maximum absolute error at most 0.02.
hypotheses.F1_specialized_charts_improve_finite_log: The local chart beats the global chart in finite logit-effect fidelity for at least three of four targets and by at least 0.05 on average.
hypotheses.F2_specialized_charts_improve_finite_ce_: The local chart beats the global chart in finite signed CE-effect fidelity for at least three of four targets and by at least 0.05 on average.
hypotheses.F3_specialized_charts_beat_equal_rank_ra: Each local chart beats the 95th percentile of sixteen matched random rank-two charts in finite logit-effect fidelity.
hypotheses.F4_local_geometry_predicts_finite_advant: Observational local-minus-global advantage correlates at least 0.50 with finite logit-fidelity advantage across the four frozen targets.
